messages:
Samira (People Ops): @here final call: the annual attestation evidence upload window closes EOD Friday (72 hours). If you’re an evidence owner, please upload artifacts or request an extension ASAP. We’ll be running a final sweep on Friday afternoon. :calendar:

Liam (Security): quick q — for staging access logs we rotated creds last week, do you want raw logs or a sanitized export?

Samira (People Ops): sanitized export + a short note saying what was removed (IPs/usernames). If the artifact contains PII, use the secure upload link below. See checklist snippet: ```- access logs (sanitized)
- config snapshots (timestamped)
- attestation note (owner + date)
- retention policy pdf or link```

Jorge (Eng): uploaded db-retention-policy_v2.pdf to the drive (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c). ping me if you can't access it. :thumbsup:

compliance-bot: Reminder automated: Outstanding items by team: Infra(2), Eng(1), Platform(0). Next auto-notify in 12h.

Maya (Legal): heads-up — if any artifact references customer data, mark the file name with `SENSITIVE` and add a one-line legal attestation in the comments. Don’t put raw PII in the public folder.

Asha (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 10:00–12:00 in #all-hands for drop-by help and screen-sharing uploads. We’ll help validate filenames and minimal redaction. :coffee:

Liam (Security): FYI we saw one upload with open permissions last week — double-check ACLs before you drop files. If you need S3 presigned links, DM me.

Jorge (Eng): got it. re-uploaded with restricted perms and left a comment with the attestation.

Samira (People Ops): Thanks! If anyone needs a short extension, mention me and the control owner in this thread — we'll triage exceptions but we prefer to keep to the deadline. Final checklist + secure upload: https://intranet.redwood/procedures/attest-2026 and secure upload: https://uploads.redwood/sec (use company SSO).

compliance-bot: NOTE: Running final validation job Friday 17:00 UTC. Files must be in the `/2026/attestations` folder by then to count.

Maya (Legal): Also tagging Legal for any contract-sensitive artifacts — @Legal please review before Friday if needed.

Asha (People Ops): Quick admin: please name files as `TEAMNAME_controlID_shortdesc_YYYYMMDD.pdf`. Example: `ENG_CTRL-13_db-retention_20260315.pdf`. Makes the validation script happy. :robot_face:

Samira (People Ops): Appreciate the hustle everyone. Will post a summary after the sweep with any outstanding controls and owners. :pray:

Liam (Security): :eyes: thanks — will monitor the compliance-bot feed and escalate if something big pops up.

Jorge (Eng): cheers, team — reach out if you want me to help with log redaction scripts (I can paste a small example).

Samira (People Ops): Perfect. If you drop files late, include a brief reason in the comment so we can log exceptions for the audit.

compliance-bot: Final automated status at 2165008922: 3 teams with missing artifacts, 14 total missing controls. End of thread.
